summary: Aethlon Medical filed an amendment to an at-the-market (ATM) prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5), updating the amount of common stock it may sell through agent H.C. Wainwright. As of May 27, 2026, the public float was $7.2M; the issuer may sell up to $542,716 of new shares under the S-3 I.B.6 one-third limitation, with $1.85M already sold in the prior 12 months. Shares trade on Nasdaq under AEMD at $3.07. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
